subject: Decision journey: starter slate + evaluation workbook (pilot timeline)
messages:
From: Claire Zhao <claire@novapulse.ai>
To: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot planning — decision journey & evaluation focus

Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. We want to pull together a short, operational workbook so our engineering and product teams can validate: accuracy on a sample set, latency under our 99th%-ile SLA, and an integration checklist for tokenization and auth.

Can you share a lightweight starter worksheet (timeline + acceptance criteria) and a draft of the stakeholder decision journey so we can align internal owners? Ideally something we can iterate on together (GDoc + an editable workbook). Target start for pilot: week of May 6.

Also looping in Tom (product lead) — he’ll drive internal testing.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Zhao
Head of Product, Novapulse

--
Attachments: none
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@novapulse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Apr 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot planning — decision journey & evaluation focus

Claire — great to hear. Attaching a compact workbook you can drop into your test plan and a short decision-journey starter document. Links below so you can edit directly:

- GDoc (starter decision journey): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Gd-example-DecisionJourneyDraft
- Workbook (xlsx): attached as \"novapulse-eval-workbook.xlsx\" — sections are:
  * Week0: sample collection & baseline metrics
  * Week1: integration smoke tests (latency/throughput)
  * Week2: quality evaluation (paired A/B on labeled set)
  * Acceptance gates: accuracy delta, 99th%-ile latency, infra/cost thresholds

Quick ask from our side: can you confirm the sample size for quality checks (we usually recommend 500–1,000 labeled examples for initial pass) and whether you have a preferred auth flow we should test (API key vs OIDC).

Proposed timeline (can compress if you have internal bandwidth):
- May 6: kick off data handoff and baseline run
- May 13: integration smoke test
- May 20: quality pass and review
- May 24: decision sync and next-step commit

If that looks reasonable I’ll invite a 30-minute alignment on Thu 5/9 with Tom + your engineering lead to walk the workbook.

Best,
Elliot Price
Enterprise Solutions — Redwood Inference
E: elliot@redwood.ai | M: +1 (415) 555-0199

--
Attachments: novapulse-eval-workbook.xlsx (xlsx, ~75KB stub)
From: Elliot Price <elliot@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Apr 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot planning — decision journey & evaluation focus

Marissa / Naomi — forwarding Claire’s note and the workbook. Two quick asks before I lock the GDoc for collaborative editing:

1) Marissa — can you scan the acceptance gates and suggest any commercial guardrails (e.g., recommended cost cap, soft vs hard gate) we should call out?
2) Naomi — can you check the security checklist section and confirm whether the requested artifact list (audit logs / retention policy) is sufficient for Novapulse’s procurement team?

I’ll set the 5/9 alignment once I have your notes — want to present a single tidy draft to Claire and Tom.

Thanks,
Elliot
